name: mcat-mastery
description: MCAT Mastery — personalized, evidence-based MCAT learning platform (browser-first).

scripts.dev:lesson: env -u HTTP_PROXY -u HTTPS_PROXY -u ALL_PROXY -u SOCKS_PROXY -u http_proxy -u https_proxy -u all_proxy -u socks_proxy VITE_AUTHORITY_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8787 pnpm --parallel --filter @mcat/local-authority --filter @mcat/learner-web run dev
scripts.dev:local: cp -n apps/learner-web/.env.example apps/learner-web/.env.local 2>/dev/null; pnpm install --prefer-offline && env -u HTTP_PROXY -u HTTPS_PROXY -u ALL_PROXY -u SOCKS_PROXY -u http_proxy -u https_proxy -u all_proxy -u socks_proxy pnpm --filter @mcat/learner-web dev
scripts.verify: pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run scan:protected
